_comment_subs: cycles_wait_128 is the shared 128c wait sub (also used by copper/plasma/parallax).
_comment_vertical: smiley is a smooth-scrolling status-split effect built from multiple CRTC cycles (display cycle + vsync cycle) with DATA-DEPENDENT register values (R6=smiley_visible, R5=smiley_line vadj) and a data-dependent display-loop trip count (224 - smiley_line). The PAL frame stays 312 by design (R5 vertical-adjust compensates the trip count), but proving that needs the vadj<->trip-count model this checker doesn't have, and the multiple loops (display ~224 scanlines, extra x8, hide x32) can't be single-loop-summed. So vertical analysis is disabled; only horizontal per-line cycle costs are annotated. The cycle-exactness that DOES matter here -- the balanced path1/path2 diamond (black-out vs NOP, both 17c) and the display-loop scanline period -- is reported by the horizontal pass.
